digest:
Nothing happened in the last 24 hours. No agent runs, no merges, no spend, no denials. There is no diff to review, so drift is zero by default rather than by good behaviour.

The cause looks structural: the backlog holds only the example task template, which is named with a .txt suffix precisely so it is ignored. Nothing is queued for the offline eval harness (M1), the triage improvements (M2) or the message work (M3). done, parked and decisions are all empty, which fits a system that was armed and then never ran a first cycle.

I also could not find a checkout of job-application-agent in this sandbox, so I could not run the test suite or confirm the 182-passed baseline. I am flagging that as unverified rather than broken.

Bottom line: the project has not moved toward the charter's definition of done, but it has not drifted away either. It needs at least one real M1 task written into the backlog before any progress can occur. Score kept at 0 so the system is not paused for an empty queue.
